clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren studies practical magic and crafts useful spells from natural reagents. He also makes arcane scrolls for his friend Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer and explorer.

In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren studies magic's practical uses. He crafts arcane formulas to solve specific problems, drawing on natural anomalies and raw components gathered across Azeroth. Their properties help him make functional scrolls and reagents for friends and travelers.

Collin Mauren is helping his friend Gaxim Rustfizzle set off NG-5 explosives from a distance. Gaxim, a gnome tinkerer, needed a way to trigger them remotely, so Collin devised a messaging spell for a scroll. To impress the spell on it, Collin uses debris from Westfall's erratic Dust Devils. He awaits word on how Gaxim's scheme fares.

Collin Mauren's studies reach from Stormwind across the Great Sea to Kalimdor's Stonetalon Mountains. He seeks the scales of the region's basilisks, whose resilient hides interest him as materials for synthesizing new spells. Travelers heading into Kalimdor often receive his requests for these rare hides. The scales fuel his study of how primal creature anatomy can steady complex enchantments.
